name: constellation
description: A typed, local-first work system for people and external MCP agents.

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run bundle -w @constellation/mcp && npm run build -w @constellation/desktop-preload && npm run build -w @constellation/desktop-ui
scripts.lint: npm run lint:code && npm run lint:md
scripts.package:alpha: npm run build && node scripts/desktop/fetch-electron.mjs && node scripts/package-alpha.mjs
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/desktop-runtime-notices.test.mjs scripts/desktop/packaged-credential-store-policy.test.mjs scripts/macos-distribution-signing.test.mjs scripts/prepare-github-release.test.mjs scripts/verify-dependency-licenses.test.mjs scripts/dev-state.test.mjs scripts/dev-snapshot.test.mjs scripts/descendant-overflow.test.mjs scripts/control-paint.test.mjs scripts/title-band-action.test.mjs scripts/heading-typography.test.mjs scripts/record-screen-geometry.test.mjs scripts/surface-height-bound.test.mjs scripts/renderer-declarations.test.mjs scripts/break-test.test.mjs scripts/run-check.test.mjs scripts/color-contrast.test.mjs scripts/status-contrast.test.mjs scripts/consumer-contrast.test.mjs scripts/desktop/production-desktop-files.test.mjs
